name: get_thought
description: Read a Planner task's thought (the plan, Markdown). Returns {thought}.

todo_id.description: Task id: the segment after /api/plan/ in the pasted URL.

file_id.description: The fileId query value from the pasted URL. Send it whenever known.

name: list_comments
description: Read a task's thought and its comments, oldest first. Returns {thought, comments: [{id, comment}]}; with open=true settled comments (Done notes, fully resolved requests) are left out and {settled: n} says how many.

file_id.description: File id from the pasted URL.

comment_id.description: Comment id: the segment after /comment/ in the pasted URL.

file_id.description: File id from the pasted URL.

name: add_comment
description: Append a new comment to a task; the server picks its id. Returns {id, thought, comment}.

file_id.description: File id from the pasted URL.

body.description: Comment text in Markdown. Must not be empty.

name: put_comment
description: Create the comment with this id, or replace its body if it exists. Use only when a specific id is wanted.

comment_id.description: Comment id to create or replace.

file_id.description: File id from the pasted URL.

body.description: Comment text in Markdown. Must not be empty.

name: edit_comment
description: Replace the whole body of an existing comment (no merge). Fails with 404 if the comment does not exist.

file_id.description: File id from the pasted URL.

body.description: The full new comment text in Markdown.

name: delete_comment
description: Delete a comment. Not undoable: only after the user confirmed or named the exact comment.

file_id.description: File id from the pasted URL.
